party_source: Groups.txt from Elections ACT (the ballot paper column headings, recased); candidates in the ungrouped column are null, because the data files don't give their labels.
instruction: Number five boxes from 1 to 5 in the order of your choice. You may then show as many further preferences as you wish by writing numbers from 6 onwards in other boxes. [Footer:] Remember, number at least five boxes from 1 to 5 in the order of your choice.
instruction_source: Elections ACT, 'Ballot papers' page (sample Yerrabi ballot paper), https://www.elections.act.gov.au/elections/our-electoral-system/elections-in-the-act/ballot-papers, read 2026-10-20. Paper ballots; the electronic voting screens may word it differently.
notes: Elections ACT ballot paper preference data, KurrajongTotal.txt (every formal ballot, paper and electronic). 25,880 electronic votes and 23,042 paper ballots. Preferences are already cut at the first missing or repeated number by Elections ACT; our check cut 0 more. blank_ballots holds all 750 informal ballots from the official statistics (not only blank ones); they aren't in the data file. Official winners in order of election, from the final distribution of preferences (table 2), Elections ACT, updated 26 October 2024. ACT counts surpluses with the last parcel of ballots received (Electoral Act 1992, Schedule 4), unlike Scottish STV.
